## What We Did
Covered the core concepts of transforming predictors into more usable features for linear regression.

## Key Concepts
Linear models can only draw straight lines through whatever you give it.

Log-transformation: convert skewed distribution to normal distribution

Square-transformation: allow for the scatterplot trend line to bend

Categorical variable: good when numbers behave like groups
case_when(): a function for creating conditional statements
cut(): a function for creating categorical variables from continuous variables
factor(): signifies groups (in cases of numerical groups)

fixed effect: dummy variable for an unmeasurable factor

## Reflection

We had already covered these transformations in statistics, so I wasn't treading new ground here. Despite that, these three categories of transforms will be extremely helpful when creating the house price predictions. I hope that these will be useful when adapting spatial features towards predicting house prices, such as distance from a park.
